newsitem.title: USA: Benham funds amonmg top performers for week - Lipper.
newsitem.headline: Benham funds amonmg top performers for week - Lipper.

text.p: Three interest-rate sensitive Benham fixed-income mutual funds were the performers for the week ended Oct 30, according to Lipper Analytical Services.
Benham Target: 2025 returned 5.99 percent for the week, Benham Target: 2020 gained 4.92 percent; and Benham Target: 2015 rose 4.06 percent, according to Lipper.
The other top performers included Rydex: US Government Bond Fund, up 3.11 percent, and Benham Target: 2010, up 2.93 percent.

Benham Target: 2025 is comprised of zero coupon bonds maturing in the year 2025. According to Lipper, fund manager David Schroeder said the fund's performance will be sensitive to change in rate direction.

The bottom five performers for the week were Dreyfus Growth & Value Funds: Dreyfus Aggressive Growth, down 7.66 percent; Dreyfus Premier Strategic Growth down 6.39 percent; Matthews International: Korea off 5.56 percent; Van Wagoner: Micro-Cap off 5.22 percent; and Foreign Fund: Mexico off 4.86 percent, according to Lipper.
